verdict.why: Generated configs no longer include nodejs_compat for compatibility dates 2026-08-04 or later, and wrangler setup removes an existing flag.

draft.detail: The flag nodejs_compat is now only added for earlier compatibility dates

source.quote: Adding the flag as well made the generated project fail to start with "The compatibility flag nodejs_compat became the default as of 2026-08-04 so does not need to be specified anymore", so the flag is now only added for earlier compatibility dates.
